_note: NHS/Trac job SEARCH via the HealthJobsUK board (trac.jobs). Verified working 2026-09-15: keyword search returns ~50 parseable NHS jobs per page. Lets the agent search Trac for ANY keyword the user wants. The homepage 403s to bots, but the job_list/ns endpoint returns 200 with a normal browser User-Agent — so send a real UA header.

params.JobSearch_q: <keyword — the job title/terms the user searches>

headers.User-Agent: a real desktop-browser UA (required — homepage blocks bots)

optional_params.JobSearch_re: region filter (hierarchical: JobSearch_re_0/_1/_2) — location is also encoded in each job URL path so can be filtered client-side

result_parsing.extract: the anchor text carries title + AfC band + NHS trust + location; the href path encodes region/town/trust/id
result_parsing.next: the /job/... advert page carries the 'apply' entry point → the pre-application questions mapped in trac_form.json

verified_examples: IT Support System Analyst Band 3 — Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells NHS Trust
IT Service Desk Engineer Band 4 — Queen Victoria Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
IT Service Desk Technician Band 4 — Sheffield Teaching Hospitals
